      CYBERTREND, as one of key player Data Science and AI company in Indonesia. Being a part of Cybertrend Team (SmartCyber) means being a part of a rapidly expanding group company, smart innovation in their excitement to Enabling Global Transformation through Intelligence People and Intelligence Technology. We value the diversity of our team because we see that innovation prospers when it is fueled by a variety of perspectives, skills, experiences, and knowledge bases.

      Our Product Department acts as the front line as a connection with the needs of markets, innovation technology and customers. Translating real feedback from the customers and market requirements into actionable insights and working actions for our product implementation team.

      Join us if you want to grow in your product career and leave your mark on a rapidly growing company.

      We Are Looking Someone With

      • Have at least 5++ years of experience in data analytical customer-facing roles and product management areas including managing high performing teams
      • The ability to grasp the breadth of the Cybertrend product vision and, at the same time, dive down to the detailed level of a specific feature.
      • Proven expertise in understanding the voice of the customer and partnering across engineering, marketing, and sales to deliver compelling products that meet those customers’ needs.
      • Ability to thrive in the dynamic environment that comes with being part of the growth company. That means flexibility and willingness to jump in and do whatever it takes to be successful.
      • Are motivated, a visionary and want to actively drive the solution innovation forward
      • Possess demonstrable experience in consultative approaches with solving your customer’s business challenges and have a track record of successfully overcoming technical challenges.
      • Possess exemplary technical business writing and communication skills and are fluent in both spoken and written English and Bahasa Indonesia (other languages are a bonus!)
      • Have a solid background knowledge and are passionate about Data Science and AI Technology.

      The Work You’ll Do

      • Define and evolve the vision, roadmap, definition of success, and ultimate company-wide impact for Cybertrend’s Product Data Science Portfolio including both customer-facing areas and platform areas.
      • Be highly data driven and use data to make the best possible decisions and evaluate different possible options and paths
      • Engage fully and directly, present features and improvements frequently and iteratively with the team. You will own getting your roadmaps out the door, and making sure that your products
      • Engage with customers, develop insights into what is possible, and uncover unarticulated customer needs
      • Work hand in hand with customers, engaging in frequent conversations from executive to individual user level to understand our customer needs

      What Cybertrend Can Offer You

      • The unique opportunity to work within data science and artificial intelligence solution for various industries – real world data science, AI , Data Management and Governance experiences
      • Investment in your personal growth and skill development (clear career paths, mentorship and coaching, learning development, etc)
      • Attractive compensation and benefits packages
      • An open-minded culture with innovative, autonomous teams
      • A clear set of company core values that guide everything we do: GROWTH mindset, SOLUTION oriented, INNOVATIVE achiever, COMPASSIONATE, GOTONG ROYONG and Cool & FUN

      • Tingkat senioritas

        Senior tingkat menengah

      • Jenis pekerjaan

        Penuh waktu

      • Fungsi pekerjaan

        Manajemen Produk, Pemasaran

      • Industri

        Layanan dan Teknologi Informasi
